data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that progressively loads larger images using low-quality image placeholders.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ProgressiveImage widget that displays a placeholder and thumbnail image with a blur effect and smooth fade-in animations before the full-resolution target image loads.
use_when: You want to progressively load large images with a smooth fade-in and blur effect.
You want to display a low-quality thumbnail or placeholder for a better user experience on slow networks.
avoid_when: You need robust offline caching capabilities provided by other image packages.
You do not use low-quality image placeholders.
strengths: Supports smooth fade-in animations to prevent image popping.
Applies a blur effect to low-resolution thumbnails to avoid pixelation.
Allows custom placeholder widgets via the ProgressiveImage.custom() constructor.
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to comprehensive caching image libraries.
Not documented for advanced disk caching or image manipulation.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides advanced caching, placeholder support, and error handling for network images.

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers flexible builders for loading, caching, and error states of images.

data.minimal_example:
ProgressiveImage(
  placeholder: AssetImage('assets/placeholder.jpg'),
  thumbnail: NetworkImage('https://i.imgur.com/7XL923M.jpg'),
  image: NetworkImage('https://i.imgur.com/xVS07vQ.jpg'),
  height: 300,
  width: 500,
)
